text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Every time she watched the Derby, her
desire grew. Every time she
watched the
Derby, her dream took shape.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Those all-important emotions became her
express ticket to victory.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
She proved worthy of her name—Winning
Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Fans forever chant for the racer who ran
with passion for the Derby,
and the
wonderful story she wove together with
her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Her story will never unravel, but instead
will be spun into new,
fantastic tales for
years to come.
